unit_agentic:
# /etc/systemd/system/agentic.service
[Unit]
Description=Agentic Engineering System (uvicorn)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=opc
WorkingDirectory=/opt/agentic-engineering-system
EnvironmentFile=-/opt/agentic-engineering-system/.env
ExecStart=/opt/agentic-engineering-system/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn api.routes:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8010 --workers 1
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
